name: PubChem
tagline: NCBI open chemistry API for structures, properties, and bioassays
description: PubChem is NCBI's free chemical information system. Its REST (PUG-REST) and related programmatic interfaces return compound structures, properties, synonyms, and bioassay data for chemistry and cheminformatics applications.

auth.details: No API key required for standard programmatic access; requests are identified by IP and subject to usage policies.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public service; subject to rate and volume policies (no paid plans)

use_cases: look up a compound by name or CID
retrieve SMILES or InChI for a structure
get bioassay activity for a chemical
